properties.description: reflow2-core's touch module (phase 7 PR 4): reads export documents and returns declared links (cross-design references), computed links (same file by repository-qualified location or URL, equal checksum outside empty and stock content, a pin naming another design's graph_id or source repository) and interface name candidates, with what was set aside and every pair's status. Writes nothing; compose.rs draws its links.
